summary: Python-based multi-agent system following modular architecture with FastAPI services, Docker containerization, and JSON schema validation. Strong emphasis on agent specialization and import-based dependency management.

rules.rule: Agent modules follow snake_case naming with descriptive suffixes (e.g., security_engineer.py, database_engineer.py)

provenance.evidence: Consistent snake_case naming across all agent modules

rules.rule: FastAPI decorators used for HTTP endpoint definition (@app.get, @app.post)
Dedicated tester agent module for test automation and validation
Dedicated security engineer agent for security analysis and remediation
JSON schema validation enforced through .deliveryos/schemas/ directory structure

lint_recommendations: Implement consistent docstring standards across all agent modules
Add type hints for all function parameters and return values
Standardize error handling patterns across FastAPI endpoints
Implement consistent logging configuration across all modules
scaffold_templates: Agent module template with base class inheritance
FastAPI service template with standard middleware
JSON schema template for new data contracts
Docker service template for new microservices
